# motherduck_attached_databases (Data Source)

Reads databases attached to the current MotherDuck SQL session.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "motherduck_attached_databases" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `rows_json` (String, Sensitive) Raw MotherDuck catalog rows encoded as JSON. Sensitive because catalog rows can include share URLs and account metadata.
